description: This file defines the `DdlReader` class responsible for reading and parsing DDL data into document objects and domain objects, supporting multiple input sources like streams, files, strings, and text readers.

classes.name: DdlReader
classes.description: A class that provides functionality to read DDL data from various sources and parse it into Document or DocumentObject instances.

methods.description: Constructor initializing DdlReader with a stream.

methods.description: Constructor initializing DdlReader with a stream and error manager.

methods.description: Constructor initializing DdlReader with a file name.

methods.name: DdlReader(string filename, DdlReaderErrors? errors)
methods.description: Constructor initializing DdlReader with a file name and error manager.

methods.description: Constructor initializing DdlReader with a TextReader.

methods.description: Closes the underlying stream or text reader if open.

methods.description: Reads and returns a Document object from the input source.
